cases.prompt: Your laboratory will start culturing primary human fibroblasts from skin biopsies and transducing them with a lentiviral vector. Write the risk assessment and control plan: hazards, containment level, cabinet and centrifuge practice, disinfectant and waste handling, the occupational health program, and what happens after an exposure.

rubric.criterion: Identifies the human primary material and the viral vector as separate hazards and ranks the procedures
Sets BSL-2 as the minimum, with open work in a certified Class II cabinet and sealed centrifuge cups opened in it
Chooses a disinfectant with a stated concentration and contact time and a validated waste method
Covers the exposure control plan, training, hepatitis B vaccination and the immediate exposure response
Routes the plan through the biosafety officer and Institutional Biosafety Committee before work begins

limitations: A zero-point self-check; it is not a grade, an approved plan or a competency record.

cases.prompt: Biosafety plan milestone 1 (suggested week 6). List agent and procedure hazards for the iPSC project, score and rank them, apply controls in hierarchy order and rescore, and name who reviews the assessment (project guide, milestone 1).

rubric.criterion: I separated agent hazards from procedure hazards.
I rescored tasks after controls applied in hierarchy order.
I named the biosafety officer and Institutional Biosafety Committee review and when to revisit.

limitations: A zero-point self-check of one project milestone; it is not a grade or a competency record.

cases.prompt: Biosafety plan milestone 2. Justify the containment level from BMBL Appendix H, list the key BSL-2 practices and cabinet procedures, and state the Bloodborne Pathogens Standard obligations with their timing (project guide, milestone 2).

rubric.criterion: I stated BSL-2 as the minimum for human cells and why.
I placed centrifugation in sealed cups opened in the cabinet.
I listed training, the exposure control plan and hepatitis B vaccination within 10 working days.

limitations: A zero-point self-check of one project milestone; it is not a grade or a competency record.

cases.prompt: Biosafety plan milestone 3. Compute the inflow and the face velocity with a raised sash, and decide what to do about a cabinet last certified 13 months ago (project guide, milestone 3).

rubric.criterion: I computed Q = v × A and the reduced face velocity.
I refused to start work until the cabinet is recertified.

limitations: A zero-point self-check of one project milestone; it is not a grade or a competency record.

rubric.criterion: I computed the bleach volume with C₁V₁ = C₂V₂.
I added the heating lag to twelve D-values.
I listed time, temperature and pressure records and biological indicators for routine cycles.

rubric.criterion: I wash or flush first, then report immediately.
